# Criticality_Induced_Plasticity

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The phenomenon where operating near criticality enhances the ability of a network to adapt its connectivity in response to input statistics. Enables self-organizing topologies in TCC/iNEST that can dynamically rewire to maintain optimal computational performance under changing workloads.
